title: Quantitative Modeling of the Short-Term Response to Nitrogen Availability that Coordinates Early Events in Lateral Root Initiation
authors: Gaudinier A; Van den Broeck L; Moreno-Risueño M; Rodriguez-Medina J; Sozzani R; Brady SM
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组和单细胞数据推断转录调控网络，识别N响应相关TF（如LBD13、ERF107）在侧根发育中的作用，但缺乏TF-DNA结合位点预测、互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅属间接相关。
abstract: Nitrogen (N) is an essential macronutrient and its bioavailability plays a major role in how plant development is tuned to environmental nutrient status. To find novel factors in early root system architecture responses to N conditions, we performed Arabidopsis thaliana root transcriptome profiling of a short-term time course in limiting and sufficient N conditions. Using this data, we inferred transcriptional regulatory networks in each condition, which revealed the N-condition specific responses of jasmonate regulation; transcriptional factor (TF) ERF107 plays a more generalized role in lateral root development while TF LBD13 is specific to N-limiting conditions. Further, we used a single cell LR cell-type specific transcriptome dataset to model and analyze the roles of TFs LBD13, ERF107, and PDF2 in early stages of LR development. Linking the N time course transcriptomics, LR mutant phenotypes, and cell-type specific single cell profiling, these approaches provide multiple lines of evidence to find and test the roles of TFs that are involved in early root patterning responses to N conditions.
abstract_zh: 氮（N）是一种必需的宏量营养素，其生物可利用性在植物发育如何适应环境养分状态中起着重要作用。为了发现根系结构早期响应氮条件的新的调控因子，我们在限制和充足氮条件下对拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）根部进行了短期时间序列的转录组分析。利用这些数据，我们推断出每种条件下的转录调控网络，揭示了茉莉酸调控的氮条件特异性响应；转录因子（TF）ERF107在侧根发育中发挥更广泛的作用，而TF LBD13则特异于氮限制条件。此外，我们利用单细胞LR细胞类型特异性转录组数据集，对转录因子LBD13、ERF107和PDF2在侧根发育早期阶段的作用进行了建模和分析。通过整合氮时间序列转录组学、侧根突变体表型以及细胞类型特异性单细胞分析，这些方法提供了多条证据链，以发现并测试参与根系早期模式形成对氮条件响应的转录因子的作用。
